name: Krita
tagline: A professional FREE and open source painting program. It is made by artists that want to see affordable art tools for everyone.
description: Krita is a professional FREE and open source painting program. It is made by artists that want to see affordable art tools for everyone.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/krita:5.3.4@sha256:cb370716097e8648755c27a48fb5783c59ee9579f48c6dce9b412779593ff95a
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
